units.source_text: “不，那是爸爸的乐趣，也是爸爸的一种消遣呀。

en.t: “No, that is Father's pleasure, and also a kind of pastime for him.

units.source_text: 如今我才感到生活的意义。”

en.t: Only now do I feel the meaning of life.”

units.source_text: 父亲也微微低下头，“尽管这张图案也显不出什么才能……”

en.t: Father also lowered his head slightly. “Though this design does not show much talent either...”
